sn47.40:1.1: “Bhikkhus, I will teach you the establishment of mindfulness, and the development of the establishment of mindfulness, and the way leading to the development of the establishment of mindfulness.
sn47.40:1.3: “And what, bhikkhus, is the establishment of mindfulness?
sn47.40:1.4: Here, bhikkhus, a bhikkhu dwells contemplating the body in the body, ardent, clearly comprehending, mindful, having removed covetousness and displeasure in regard to the world.
sn47.40:1.5: He dwells contemplating feelings in feelings …
sn47.40:1.7: phenomena in phenomena, ardent, clearly comprehending, mindful, having removed covetousness and displeasure in regard to the world.
sn47.40:1.8: This is called the establishment of mindfulness.
sn47.40:2.1: “And what, bhikkhus, is the development of the establishment of mindfulness?
sn47.40:2.2: Here, bhikkhus, a bhikkhu dwells contemplating the nature of origination in the body; he dwells contemplating the nature of vanishing in the body; he dwells contemplating the nature of origination and vanishing in the body—ardent, clearly comprehending, mindful, having removed covetousness and displeasure in regard to the world.
sn47.40:2.3: He dwells contemplating the nature of origination in feelings …
sn47.40:2.4: He dwells contemplating the nature of origination in mind …
sn47.40:2.5: He dwells contemplating the nature of origination in phenomena; he dwells contemplating the nature of vanishing in phenomena; he dwells contemplating the nature of origination and vanishing in phenomena—ardent, clearly comprehending, mindful, having removed covetousness and displeasure in regard to the world.
sn47.40:2.6: This is called the development of the establishment of mindfulness.
sn47.40:3.1: “And what, bhikkhus, is the way leading to the development of the establishment of mindfulness?
sn47.40:3.2: It is this Noble Eightfold Path; that is,
sn47.40:3.4: This is called the way leading to the development of the establishment of mindfulness.”
